title: Hearing on AI use and student data privacy in schools
summary: The Council's Education and Technology Committees held a joint oversight hearing examining how the Department of Education uses artificial intelligence tools, including student-facing chatbots and admissions algorithms, and how student data is protected under state and city law. The hearing also considered five bills, including measures requiring disclosure of school admissions policies, studies on language access and program equity, and annual and quarterly reporting on algorithmic tools and data breaches in schools. Witnesses invited included DOE, the Office of Technology and Innovation, advocacy groups, educators, parents and students.
